title: Non-supersymmetric heterotic strings on $AdS_{4}\times S^{3}\times S^{3}$
summary: We analyze the stability properties of a family of anti-de Sitter flux compactifications of the tachyon-free non-supersymmetric heterotic string in ten dimensions. In contrast with simpler such solutions, the solutions include two independent unbounded fluxes, leading to richer instability phenomena. In particular, when the two fluxes are sufficiently close in magnitude, the perturbative spectrum develops tachyonic modes, which can be projected out by an orbifold action.
